title: SII Vol. 19 No. 106 — Tiruvidaikkali

title: SII Vol. 19 No. 108
location_detail: On the south wall of the same shrine

title: SII Vol. 19 No. 110
location_detail: On the west wall of the central shrine, Vatamulesvara temple in the same village
summary: This records a gift of 909 sheep for burning a perpetual lamp in the temple of Tiruvalandurai-Mahadeva at Siru-Paluvur in Kunra-kurram, by Nilaiyan Vemban a resident of the village

title: SII Vol. 19 No. 111 — Tiruppalanam
location_detail: On the west wall of the central shrine, Apatsahyesvara temple
summary: This records a gift of 90 sheep for a lamp in the temple of Mahadeva at Tiruppalanam in Virai-kurram by Pandan Kantabaranan alias Vana . . . . . . . of Purakkiliyur-nadu

location_detail: On the South wall of the central shrine, Saptarishisvara temple

location_detail: On the north wall of the central shrine, Tirukkotisvara temple

title: SII Vol. 19 No. 115
location_detail: On the west wall of the same shrine

title: SII Vol. 19 No. 116 — Tiruppundurutti
location_detail: On the north wall of the central shrine, Pushpavanesvara temple
summary: This records a gift of 96 sheep of made by Pisangan Korran Arkkattuvelan resident of nanandur in Arkkattu-kurram, to the temple fo mahadeva at Tirutturutti, fr burning a perpetual lamp in the shrine of the goddess and for worship during a service therein called the santi-villa

title: SII Vol. 19 No. 117
location_detail: On the west wall of the same shrine

title: SII Vol. 19 No. 119 — Vedaranyam
location_detail: On a pillar in the mandapa in front of the central shrine, Vedaranyesvara temple
summary: This records a gift of 90 sheep for burning a perpetual lamp in the temple of Madevar at Tirumaraikkadu by one Madevan

title: SII Vol. 19 No. 120
location_detail: On the fourth pillar in the mandapa in front of Tyagaraja shrine in the same temple
summary: It records some provision (gift of sheep) for burning a perpetual lamp in the temple by one Palai Erkutti a merchant of Tamaraippundi a devadana in Umbala-nadu

title: SII Vol. 19 No. 121 — Tirupparkadal
location_detail: On the south wall of the central shrine, Kharapurisvara temple
summary: This records an agreement by the maha-sabha of Kavidippakkam alias Amaninarayana-chaturvedimangalam in Paduvur-kottam through their Tank Supervision Committee to burn a perpetual lamp in the local temple of Tirukkarapurattu-Perumanadigal and in that of Tiruvagattisvarattu Perumanadigal at Pakkam

title: SII Vol. 19 No. 122 — Tiruvisalur
location_detail: On the north wall of the central shrine, Sivayoganathasvami temple

title: SII Vol. 19 No. 123 — Puvalaikkudi
location_detail: On the south wall of the mandapa in front of the rock-cut cave

title: SII Vol. 19 No. 125 — Tiruvisalur
location_detail: On the north wall of the central shrine, Sivayoganathasvai temple
summary: It records a gift for burning a perpetual lamp in the temple of Perumanadigal at Tiruvisalur
